name: hercules-pro
description: A read-only ChatGPT financial teacher grounded in your live Hearth ledgers.

interface.shortDescription: Ask your Hearth books in ChatGPT
interface.longDescription: Hercules Pro uses sixteen read-only Hearth tools to explain personal and shared household ledgers. It can investigate posted facts and teach, but cannot change money.
defaultPrompt: Can I afford groceries this week?
Explain where our household money went this month.
Teach me what my card balance means.
